site_name: Flat 14, Empire House, Thurloe Place, LONDON, SW7 2RU
description: Internal structural and non-structural alterations with new mechanical and electrical services and finishes as follows: Alterations to all walls, removal of joinery, suspended ceiling to hallway & entrance lobby. Creation of living/ dining room with kitchen in the area currently a living room and bedroom 03; creation of master bedroom and ensuite in the area currently a kitchen, utility and wc. Insertion of stud partitions forming bathroom and utility room in the area currently bathrooms 01 & 02. New types of flooring installation (marble and engineered timber flooring) fitted without the removal of historic skirtings; custom made joinery for all rooms and kitchen. New electrical layouts and refurbishment of historic radiators  ***WITHDRAWN***
